name: The Kettle's Request
description: Old Hermit Yun would like proof you have walked among the bamboo: a single Bamboo Viper fang.

name: Study the Sutra
description: Read the Sutra of Empty Sleeves you were given, and return to Librarian Zhao.

name: The Envoy's Letter
description: Envoy Ruwen of the Azure Cloud has a sealed letter for Matriarch Shan of the Five Poisons Sect. Her arm is broken; she cannot cross the valley herself. Carry the letter to the Hall of Five Poisons, place it in the Matriarch's hands, and return.

name: The Missing Disciple
description: An inner disciple has not returned from the foothills. The frost wolves are hungry. Find any sign — and survive what hunts there.
